models.name: ecommerce_mall_customers
models.description: Customer account records with email/password authentication credentials and profile information including display name, phone number, and account status. This table serves as the primary identity record for customers who browse products, add to cart, place orders, write reviews, and manage wishlists. Account deletion removes profile information but preserves order history, reviews, and other transactional data for seller records and legal purposes.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer email address for authentication and account identification. Must be unique across all customer accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication. Never store plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Customer's display name shown in reviews, order history, and public-facing areas. Optional field that customers can edit.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Customer's phone number for account verification and order notifications. Optional field that customers can edit.

plainFields.name: account_status
plainFields.description: Account status enum: 'active' for normal accounts, 'suspended' for temporary restrictions, 'banned' for permanent access denial. Controls login capability and platform access.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created. Used for audit trail and account age tracking.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last modified. Updated on profile changes and status transitions.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was soft-deleted. When null, account is active. Account deletion removes profile data but preserves orders, reviews, and transactional history.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for customer authentication with access and refresh token support for secure session management. Stores connection metadata including IP address, page href, and referrer for security auditing. Sessions are append-only records tracked through authentication flows, not direct user CRUD operations. Each session has an expiration timestamp for security compliance.

Relationships:
- Belongs to {@link ecommerce_mall_customers} - the authenticated customer actor
- One customer can have multiple active sessions simultaneously

Security Notes:
- Sessions are immutable once created
- expired_at timestamp enforces session lifetime limits
- Connection metadata enables security auditing and anomaly detection

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Authenticated customer's {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address for connection tracking and security auditing.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Page href where authentication occurred for connection context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for connection context and security auditing.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp for audit trail.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for security compliance. Sessions beyond this timestamp are considered invalid.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for customer account recovery with expiration timestamps for security. Each reset request creates a new token that expires after a configured duration. When a customer successfully resets their password, the used_at timestamp is recorded. Multiple reset requests can exist per customer, but only unexpired unused tokens are valid for password recovery.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer account requesting password reset. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secure password reset token generated for the request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset request was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token expires. Tokens cannot be used after this time.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was used. Nullable until the token is consumed for password reset.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset record was last updated.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens for customer registration to confirm email ownership before account activation. Each record stores a unique verification token linked to a pending customer account, with expiration timestamps and verification completion tracking. These records are created during registration and consumed upon successful email verification.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer account being verified. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token sent to customer email for ownership confirmation.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Verification must complete before this time.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when email verification was completed. Null before verification, set upon successful confirmation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for record archival.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_sellers
models.description: Seller account records with email/password authentication credentials and shop profile including shop name, description, and approval status for administrator review workflow. Sellers require administrator approval before they can sell products, and their accounts can be suspended or banned by administrators. When sellers delete their accounts, their order history and snapshots are preserved for business records while their products are removed from listings.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for seller authentication and account identification.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication.

plainFields.name: shop_name
plainFields.description: Public shop name displayed to customers on product listings and seller profiles.

plainFields.name: shop_description
plainFields.description: Optional descriptive text about the seller's shop, products, or business.

plainFields.name: approval_status
plainFields.description: Administrator approval status: pending (awaiting review), approved (can sell), rejected (must reapply). Determines seller's ability to create products and process orders.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Optional reason provided by administrator when seller approval is rejected. Visible to seller for reapplication guidance.

plainFields.name: account_status
plainFields.description: Account lifecycle status: active (normal operation), suspended (temporary restriction by admin), banned (permanent access denial). Affects login ability and product visibility.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was soft-deleted. Null for active accounts. Account deletion removes products from listings but preserves order history and snapshots.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for seller authentication with access and refresh token support for secure session management. Each session record tracks connection metadata (IP address, origin, referrer) and expiration timestamps for security auditing. Sessions are append-only records that support the seller login workflow and are managed through authentication flows rather than direct CRUD operations. Sessions belong to {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers} and enable secure stateless authentication with token refresh capabilities.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sellers_id
foreignFields.description: Seller account this session belongs to. {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token for authenticated API requests. Short-lived token used for authorization.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token for obtaining new access tokens. Long-lived token used for session renewal.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from the login request. Used for security auditing and anomaly detection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Client origin URL (window.location.href) from the login request. Used for session context tracking.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header from the login request. Used for security auditing and navigation tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created (login time). Used for session age calculation and auditing.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires. Sessions beyond this timestamp are invalid and should be rejected. NOT NULL for security.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens for seller account recovery with expiration timestamps for security. These tokens are generated when a seller requests password reset and are validated during the reset process. Each token is single-use and expires after a defined period to prevent unauthorized access.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller account requesting password reset. {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique password reset token generated for verification.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Tokens become invalid after this time for security.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for audit trail.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_admins
models.description: Administrator account records with email/password authentication credentials and admin grade (regular/super) for privilege-based access control. Regular administrators can manage sellers, categories, products, orders, and users. Super administrators have additional privileges to promote/demote administrators and manage system-wide settings. Account status supports active, suspended, and banned states for access control.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Administrator email address for authentication. Must be unique across all administrator accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication. Never stored or transmitted in plain text.

plainFields.name: admin_grade
plainFields.description: Administrator privilege level. "regular" for standard administrators with management capabilities. "super" for super administrators with additional privileges including admin promotion/demotion.

plainFields.name: account_status
plainFields.description: Account access state. "active" for normal operation. "suspended" for temporary access restriction. "banned" for permanent access denial preventing login.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was soft-deleted. Null for active accounts.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_admin_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for administrator authentication with access and refresh token support for secure session management. Stores connection metadata including IP address, client URL, and referrer for audit trails. Sessions are append-only records managed through authentication flows with expiration timestamps for security.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator account's {@link ecommerce_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from the login request for security auditing.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Client URL/URI from the login request.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Client referrer URL/URI from the login request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Session last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Session soft delete timestamp for session invalidation.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for security. Sessions are automatically invalidated after this time.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_admin_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for administrator account recovery with expiration timestamps for security. Each token is single-use and expires after a configured duration to prevent unauthorized access. Tokens are created when an administrator requests password reset and invalidated after use or expiration.

This table supports the {@link ecommerce_mall_admins} actor's authentication recovery workflow. Tokens reference the requesting administrator and contain cryptographic reset tokens with connection context for security auditing.

Security considerations:
- Tokens are single-use and invalidated after password change
- Expiration timestamps prevent indefinite token validity
- Connection metadata (ip, href, referrer) enables audit trails
- Indexes optimize token lookup and cleanup queries

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator account requesting password reset. {@link ecommerce_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Cryptographic reset token for password recovery. Single-use token that is invalidated after successful password change or expiration.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from password reset request. Records the source IP for security auditing and fraud detection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URL/URI where password reset was initiated. Tracks the endpoint that triggered the reset request.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header from password reset request. Provides context about the requesting page for audit trails.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Tokens become invalid after this time to prevent unauthorized access.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Token creation timestamp. Records when the password reset request was initiated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp. Tracks last modification to the reset token record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Marks the token as used or invalidated while preserving audit history.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_inventory_records
models.description: Stock quantity change history for product variants, tracking all inventory modifications including restocking, order deductions, cancellation/refund restorations, and manual adjustments. Each record captures the quantity change amount, reason for change, timestamp, and current stock level after the change. Current stock is calculated by summing all historical records for a variant. This table supports audit trails and dispute resolution for inventory discrepancies.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant whose inventory is being tracked. {@link ecommerce_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity_change
plainFields.description: Amount of stock quantity change. Positive values indicate restocking or restorations (cancellation/refund). Negative values indicate deductions (orders, adjustments, losses).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason for the inventory change. Examples: 'restock', 'order_placement', 'cancellation_approved', 'refund_approved', 'manual_adjustment', 'inventory_loss'.

plainFields.name: recorded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory change occurred. Server-generated to ensure accurate chronological ordering of inventory history.

plainFields.name: current_stock
plainFields.description: Stock quantity after this change was applied. Snapshot of current stock at the time of recording, useful for quick verification without recalculating from history.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for audit trail.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp for audit trail.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Inventory records should typically not be deleted to maintain audit trail integrity.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_order_item_snapshots
models.description: Immutable audit trail snapshots capturing order item state at purchase time. Records complete product details (name, description), variant options (SKU, option values), pricing information, and seller profile (shop name, logo) as they existed when the order was placed. These snapshots are critical for dispute resolution, purchase history verification, and preserving seller profile information even after sellers modify their shops or delete accounts. Snapshots are append-only and cannot be deleted, maintaining a permanent record of all transactions on this money-exchange platform. Each order item may have multiple snapshots if modified after purchase (e.g., status changes, cancellation/refund requests).

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced order item's {@link ecommerce_mall_order_items.id}. Each order item can have multiple snapshots over its lifecycle (purchase, status changes, cancellation, refund).

foreignFields.name: changed_by_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who triggered this snapshot change. Nullable for system-created snapshots (e.g., automatic purchase snapshots). References {@link ecommerce_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: snapshot_type
plainFields.description: Type of snapshot event. Values: 'purchase' (initial order creation), 'status_change' (item status update), 'cancellation' (cancellation request), 'refund' (refund request). Distinguishes different lifecycle events for the same order item.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created. For purchase snapshots, this equals the order creation time. For subsequent snapshots, this captures when the change occurred.

plainFields.name: previous_values
plainFields.description: JSON object containing the order item state before this change. Null for initial purchase snapshots. Contains fields like: productName, productDescription, variantSku, variantOptions, unitPrice, sellerShopName, sellerLogo, itemStatus, etc.

plainFields.name: current_values
plainFields.description: JSON object containing the complete order item state after this change. Always populated. Contains: productName, productDescription, variantSku, variantOptions, unitPrice, sellerShopName, sellerLogo, itemStatus, quantity, and all other order item fields at snapshot time.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_review_snapshots
models.description: Immutable audit trail snapshots capturing all review modifications including rating changes, content edits, and deletion status. Each snapshot records the complete state of a review before and after modification, with timestamp and the customer who made the change. Snapshots are preserved even after review deletion for dispute resolution and audit purposes. {@link ecommerce_mall_reviews} {@link ecommerce_mall_customers}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: Target review's {@link ecommerce_mall_reviews.id}. The review entity that was modified and triggered this snapshot creation.

foreignFields.name: changed_by_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who made the change's {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}. Records the actor responsible for the review modification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was created. Server-enforced to ensure audit trail integrity.

plainFields.name: previous_values
plainFields.description: JSON string containing the review state before modification. Includes rating (1-5), content (text), and isDeleted (boolean) fields.

plainFields.name: current_values
plainFields.description: JSON string containing the review state after modification. Includes rating (1-5), content (text), and isDeleted (boolean) fields.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_snapshots
models.description: Immutable audit trail capturing seller profile modifications including shop name, description, and logo changes. Each snapshot records the complete seller state at the time of modification with previous and current values, timestamp, and the administrator who made the change (if applicable). Snapshots are preserved for dispute resolution and administrator oversight, even after seller account deletion. This table supports the snapshot principle requiring all data modifications in this money-exchange platform to be recorded with before/after values.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller account whose profile was modified. {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who made the profile change. Null when seller updates their own profile. {@link ecommerce_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was created. Always set by server at modification time.

plainFields.name: previous_values
plainFields.description: JSON string containing seller profile values before the modification. Includes shop_name, shop_description, and logo fields.

plainFields.name: current_values
plainFields.description: JSON string containing seller profile values after the modification. Includes shop_name, shop_description, and logo fields.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_categories
models.description: Product categories with hierarchical structure supporting one level of nesting (parent categories and subcategories). Categories organize products for customer browsing and filtering. Each category can have a parent category to create subcategories, but nesting is limited to one level. Categories are managed exclusively by administrators. Referenced by {@link ecommerce_mall_products} for product categorization.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent category for subcategory hierarchy. Null for top-level categories. Enables one-level nesting structure (parent → subcategory). {@link ecommerce_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category name. Must be unique across all categories. Used for display and product filtering.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional category description providing additional context about the category's purpose and product types.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was created. Records the initial creation time for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was last modified. Updated on every edit operation.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was soft-deleted. Null for active categories. Preserves category for historical product records.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_category_snapshots
models.description: Immutable audit trail capturing all category modifications with before/after values. Preserves category change history for administrator oversight and dispute resolution as required by the snapshot principle. Each snapshot records the complete category state at the time of modification, including name, description, and parent relationship changes.

foreignFields.name: category_id
foreignFields.description: Target category's {@link ecommerce_mall_categories.id}. The category entity that was modified.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who made the modification. {@link ecommerce_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: previous_values
plainFields.description: JSON string containing the category state before modification. Includes name, description, and parentId fields as they existed prior to the change.

plainFields.name: current_values
plainFields.description: JSON string containing the category state after modification. Includes name, description, and parentId fields as they exist after the change.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category modification occurred and snapshot was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot record was last updated. Maintains schema consistency with other entities.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Snapshots are typically immutable and preserved, but this field maintains schema consistency with other entities.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_products
models.description: Core product catalog entities representing items sold by sellers. Each product has a name, description, category classification, and base price. Products belong to a seller who owns and manages them. Products can be edited, with each modification creating a snapshot in ecommerce_mall_product_snapshots for audit trail. Products can be soft-deleted or suspended by administrators. Products have multiple variants (ecommerce_mall_product_variants) representing different SKUs with options like color and size, and multiple images (ecommerce_mall_product_images) with the first image serving as thumbnail.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who owns and manages this product. {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: category_id
foreignFields.description: Category classification for product organization and browsing. {@link ecommerce_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name. Required field for product identification and search.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Product description providing detailed information about the product.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base price of the product in currency units. Variants can override this price.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Product lifecycle status: active (visible and purchasable), deleted (soft-deleted, hidden from listings), suspended (hidden by administrator for policy violations).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was last modified. Triggers snapshot creation.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was soft-deleted. Null if product is active or suspended.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variants
models.description: SKU variants for products with unique SKU codes, optional price override, and stock quantity tracking. Each variant belongs to exactly one {@link ecommerce_mall_products} and represents a specific product configuration that customers can purchase. Variant option values (e.g., color, size) are stored in {@link ecommerce_mall_product_variant_options} for 1NF compliance. Variant edits create snapshots in {@link ecommerce_mall_product_snapshots} for audit trail. Stock quantity is tracked through {@link ecommerce_mall_inventory_records} history rather than stored directly.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product's {@link ecommerce_mall_products.id}. Each variant belongs to exactly one product.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique SKU code identifying this variant. Must be unique across all variants in the system.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Optional price override for this variant. If null, uses the product's base price from {@link ecommerce_mall_products.basePrice}.

plainFields.name: stock_quantity
plainFields.description: Current stock quantity for this variant. Calculated from sum of all {@link ecommerce_mall_inventory_records} for this variant. Zero means out of stock.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null means active, non-null means deleted.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_product_images
models.description: Product images supporting multiple uploads per product with reorder capability. The first image (sort_order=0) serves as the main thumbnail displayed in search results and category listings. Image changes and reordering are captured in product snapshots for audit trail purposes. Images are always managed through their parent {@link ecommerce_mall_products} entity and cannot be independently created or deleted outside of product operations.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product's {@link ecommerce_mall_products.id}. Images always belong to exactly one product and are deleted when the product is deleted.

plainFields.name: url
plainFields.description: URL reference to the stored image file. Points to CDN or file storage location where the image is hosted.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: Display order position for reordering images. Lower values appear first. The image with sort_order=0 serves as the main thumbnail.

plainFields.name: is_primary
plainFields.description: Whether this image is the primary/thumbnail image. True for the first image (sort_order=0), false for all others. Used for quick thumbnail identification.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this image record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this image record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this image was soft-deleted. Null if the image is still active.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_product_snapshots
models.description: Immutable audit trail capturing complete product state at each edit, including all variant information. Records previous values, current values, creation timestamp, and the seller who made the change. Snapshots are preserved even after product deletion and can be viewed by sellers and administrators for dispute resolution. {@link ecommerce_mall_products} {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_products_id
foreignFields.description: Product being snapshotted. {@link ecommerce_mall_products.id}

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_sellers_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who made the change. Nullable for system-generated or administrator actions. {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: previous_values
plainFields.description: JSON object containing all product fields and variant data before the change.

plainFields.name: current_values
plainFields.description: JSON object containing all product fields and variant data after the change.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was created. Server-enforced.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variant_options
models.description: Normalized key-value storage for product variant option values (e.g., color, size, material). Each row stores one option attribute for a variant, replacing JSON storage to ensure First Normal Form (1NF) compliance. This table enables atomic querying and filtering of variant options while maintaining referential integrity with {@link ecommerce_mall_product_variants.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged product variant's {@link ecommerce_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Option attribute name (e.g., "color", "size", "material").

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Option attribute value (e.g., "Red", "Large", "Cotton").

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for audit trail preservation.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_orders
models.description: Main order records representing customer purchases with unique order numbers, embedded shipping address snapshots, total price, and overall status derived from order items. Orders are created after successful payment and shipping address is locked at order time, preserving the address even if the customer later modifies their saved addresses.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who placed this order. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Unique order identifier for customer reference and tracking.

plainFields.name: shipping_recipient_name
plainFields.description: Recipient name for shipping address, captured at order time and locked thereafter.

plainFields.name: shipping_phone_number
plainFields.description: Recipient phone number for shipping address, captured at order time and locked thereafter.

plainFields.name: shipping_street_address
plainFields.description: Street address for shipping, captured at order time and locked thereafter.

plainFields.name: shipping_city
plainFields.description: City for shipping address, captured at order time and locked thereafter.

plainFields.name: shipping_state
plainFields.description: State or province for shipping address, captured at order time and locked thereafter.

plainFields.name: shipping_postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal code for shipping address, captured at order time and locked thereafter.

plainFields.name: shipping_country
plainFields.description: Country for shipping address, captured at order time and locked thereafter.

plainFields.name: total_price
plainFields.description: Total order price including all items.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Overall order status derived from order items: paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded, or partiallyCompleted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Order creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Order last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for order archival.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_order_items
models.description: Individual purchased product variants within orders with independent status tracking. Each order item represents a specific variant purchase with quantity, unit price at time of purchase, and status that can be independently cancelled or refunded. Order item status determines overall order status through derivation rules.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Parent order's {@link ecommerce_mall_orders.id}. Order items belong to orders and inherit order-level context.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Purchased product variant's {@link ecommerce_mall_product_variants.id}. Links to the specific SKU variant that was purchased.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of this variant purchased in the order item. Must be positive integer.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Unit price at time of purchase. Immutable after order creation. Snapshot preserves this value for dispute resolution.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Order item status: paid (payment completed), shipped (seller shipped), delivered (customer received), cancelled (cancelled by customer/seller/admin), refunded (refunded after delivery). Status transitions follow business rules.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when order item was created (at order placement).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when order item was last updated (status changes, etc.).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for audit trail. Order items are rarely deleted but soft delete preserves historical integrity.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_shipments
models.description: Shipping packages created by sellers containing one or more order items with tracking information. Each shipment represents a physical package sent to customers with carrier details and tracking numbers. Shipment creation updates order item statuses to 'shipped', and delivery confirmation (manual or automatic after 14 days) updates items to 'delivered'. Different sellers always create separate shipments even for the same order.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who created and ships this package. {@link ecommerce_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Unique tracking number assigned by the carrier for shipment tracking.

plainFields.name: carrier_name
plainFields.description: Name of the shipping carrier (e.g., FedEx, UPS, DHL).

plainFields.name: shipped_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller shipped this package and order items transitioned to 'shipped' status.

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when customer confirmed delivery or automatic delivery after 14 days. Null if not yet delivered.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for audit trail preservation.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_addresses
models.description: Customer shipping addresses with recipient details and location information. Supports multiple addresses per customer with one default selection for checkout convenience. Addresses are preserved when deleted (soft delete) to maintain order history integrity. Each address contains complete delivery information including recipient name, phone number, street address, city, state/province, postal code, and country.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this address. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Name of the person receiving the delivery.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Contact phone number for delivery coordination.

plainFields.name: street_address
plainFields.description: Street address including building number and street name.

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City or municipality name.

plainFields.name: state_province
plainFields.description: State, province, or region name.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal or ZIP code for the address.

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Country name or ISO country code.

plainFields.name: is_default
plainFields.description: Whether this address is the customer's default shipping address. Only one default address allowed per customer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the address was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the address was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the address was soft-deleted. Null if address is active.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_reviews
models.description:
Customer reviews for products with ratings (1-5 stars) and optional text content. Each review is tied to a specific order item to enforce one-review-per-order policy. Reviews can be soft-deleted but remain visible as "deleted user" content. Average product ratings are calculated from non-deleted reviews.

Key relationships:
- Belongs to {@link ecommerce_mall_customers} - the customer who wrote the review
- Belongs to {@link ecommerce_mall_products} - the product being reviewed
- Belongs to {@link ecommerce_mall_order_items} - the purchased item that enabled review eligibility

Behavioral notes:
- One review per order item enforced via unique constraint
- Review only allowed after order item status becomes "delivered"
- Soft-delete preserves review content for historical records
- Snapshots for review edits are stored in ecommerce_mall_review_snapshots

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who wrote this review. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: Product being reviewed. {@link ecommerce_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Order item that enabled review eligibility. Ensures one review per order item (one review per product per order). {@link ecommerce_mall_order_items.id}.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Star rating from 1 to 5. Required field for all reviews.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Optional text content of the review. Can be empty or contain detailed feedback.

plainFields.name: is_deleted
plainFields.description: Soft-delete flag. When true, review is hidden from listings but preserved for historical records. Deleted reviews are shown as "deleted user" content.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was initially created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was last modified. Updated on each edit.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was soft-deleted. Null if review is active.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_wishlists
models.description: Customer wishlist entries linking customers to saved products for later purchase. Each row represents one product saved by one customer, tracking when it was added and its active status for pagination and filtering. Products can be removed from wishlist at any time, and deleted products are automatically removed via application logic or cascade.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who added this product to their wishlist. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product saved to wishlist. If deleted by seller, this entry should be removed. {@link ecommerce_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was added to the wishlist.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this wishlist entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this wishlist entry was soft-deleted (removed from wishlist). Null if still active.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether this wishlist entry is active (visible in customer's wishlist). Used for pagination and filtering.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_cart_items
models.description: Shopping cart items linking customers to product variants with quantities and availability status. Customers can add specific variants to their cart, update quantities, and receive stock warnings. Cart items are removed after successful order placement. This table supports the pre-purchase product selection and quantity management workflow.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this cart item. {@link ecommerce_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Product variant added to cart. {@link ecommerce_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity of this variant in the cart. Must be positive integer.

plainFields.name: is_available
plainFields.description: Whether the variant is still available (in stock and not deleted). Set to false when variant goes out of stock or is deleted by seller.

plainFields.name: added_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this item was added to the cart.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart item record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the quantity was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart item was soft-deleted (e.g., during checkout or manual removal).

models.name: ecommerce_mall_order_item_cancellation_requests
models.description: Cancellation requests for individual order items with 'paid' status. Customers can request cancellation with a reason, and sellers can approve or reject the request. Each request tracks the workflow state with timestamps for audit purposes. When approved, the order item is cancelled and stock is restored via inventory records. Snapshots of request state changes are preserved for dispute resolution.

foreignFields.name: order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Target order item's {@link ecommerce_mall_order_items.id} for which this cancellation is requested.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer-provided reason for requesting cancellation.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current workflow status: 'pending' (awaiting seller response), 'approved' (seller approved, item cancelled), or 'rejected' (seller rejected, item continues processing).

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer submitted the cancellation request.

plainFields.name: responded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller responded to the cancellation request (approved or rejected). Null while request is pending.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for audit trail.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp for audit trail.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Requests are preserved for audit even when logically deleted.

models.name: ecommerce_mall_order_item_refund_requests
models.description: Refund requests for delivered order items within the 7-day refund window. Each request includes a reason, tracks the approval workflow status (pending, approved, rejected), and records when the request was made and when the seller responded. These requests enable customers to seek refunds for delivered products while maintaining audit trails through snapshots.

foreignFields.name: ecommerce_mall_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Target order item's {@link ecommerce_mall_order_items.id} for which this refund request was created.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Customer-provided reason for requesting the refund.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the refund request workflow: pending (awaiting seller response), approved (seller approved refund), or rejected (seller denied refund).

plainFields.name: requested_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer submitted the refund request.

plainFields.name: responded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller responded to the refund request (approved or rejected). Null while request is pending.

plainFields.name: days_since_delivery
plainFields.description: Number of days elapsed since the order item was delivered. Used to enforce the 7-day refund window eligibility.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp for tracking modifications.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Refund requests are typically preserved for audit but may be soft-deleted for archival purposes.
